verdict.rationale: Belvo has a dedicated Brazil aggregation institutions page with a linked institution status page, and a community member confirms the developer docs list the supported banks. Coverage geographies are visible across the docs: Brazil for aggregation, payments and employment, Mexico and Chile for fiscal data, and Latin America overall. Missing for 10: any published institution counts or coverage-reach numbers, per-country institution lists beyond Brazil, and independent verification of how complete the coverage is.
